name: manual_a4a165
claim: When cherry-reanchoring a stale branch onto a rewritten/advanced main and hitting an add/add or content conflict, don't resolve by reflexively picking a side -- check whether origin/main's CURRENT full file already contains the branch's content (possibly refined, redacted, or relocated), whether the same lesson/memory IDs already exist on main with equal-or-better text, and for gitlink/submodule conflicts, which SHA is actually ahead. A resolution of 'take origin/main entirely, cherry-pick becomes empty' is a common, CORRECT outcome for old branches, not a failed reconciliation.

decisions.notes: 2026-08-09 PT branch reanchor operation: 4 branches (periscope-l4-adapter-f559, reanchor/fix6-ci-gemini-env, reanchor/pr309-review-followup, post-grant-followup-pt), 19 total commits across them, ALL resolved to zero net-unique content after verification -- confirmed via patch-id comparison against main's lessons.jsonl/LESSONS.md/AGENT_LEARNINGS.jsonl (same lesson IDs already present, sometimes with an explicit later refinement), and via checking a submodule gitlink conflict where the branch's pin was older than main's current pin -- applying it would have been a regression, not a reconciliation.

rationale: 2026-08-09 PT branch reanchor operation: 4 branches (periscope-l4-adapter-f559, reanchor/fix6-ci-gemini-env, reanchor/pr309-review-followup, post-grant-followup-pt), 19 total commits across them, ALL resolved to zero net-unique content after verification -- confirmed via patch-id comparison against main's lessons.jsonl/LESSONS.md/AGENT_LEARNINGS.jsonl (same lesson IDs already present, sometimes with an explicit later refinement), and via checking a submodule gitlink conflict where the branch's pin was older than main's current pin -- applying it would have been a regression, not a reconciliation.
